metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Safeguard G Tier 1 (military suppression) + Mod8 (violence-RISK vs AGENCY): does ethnic bifurcation plus low-moderate P1 predict RECURRENT COUPS rather than large-scale civil war? Whether the 2013 'ethnically blind' constitution and the 2022 peaceful turnover end the cycle is the trajectory sub-test. MODERATE data (P2 unavailable) -> DIRECTIONAL ONLY, never used for fine ordinal ranking.
metadata.notes: Reference-based record. Real MI v2 re-scores (P2 unavailable -> null). 1987 / 2000 / 2006 coups -> 2022 transition; scored ~1996 vs 2024. Flagged directional-only per the framework's data-limited rule.

pre_event.event_description: Between the 1987 coups and the 2000 coup; an indigenous-Fijian / Indo-Fijian ethnic cleavage politically entrenched, with the military a recurring veto actor.

Fiji.notes: Inputs resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year). WGI 2025-anchored 0-100. MODERATE data coverage (P2 / economic-complexity pillar unavailable). DIRECTIONAL-ONLY case: do not use for fine ordinal rankings.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Directional: instability/stagnation persists through the coup cycle; rising P1 after a credible institutional reset (2013 constitution) is required to end it
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Low-moderate P1 + entrenched ethnic cleavage + military-dominant veto
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Stable consolidation with no further coups absent any institutional reset

b_violence.prediction: Recurrent COUPS (elite/military seizures), NOT large-scale ethnic civil war
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY; the military is the proximate agent, the framework reads structural risk
b_violence.falsification_condition: Either large-scale civil war OR no further coups

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Failure dimension = political/institutional (P1) - contested executive legitimacy along the ethnic cleavage
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Failure driven by an economic/non-P1 dimension

f_reversal_risk.prediction: High reversal risk while the cycle persists; declining if the 2013 reset and a peaceful turnover hold
f_reversal_risk.falsification_condition: No reversal despite no institutional reset

g_suppression_mechanism.falsification_condition: Suppression turns out to be purely legal/non-coercive

Fiji.outcome_summary: Recurrent coups as predicted, NOT civil war: 1987 (x2), 2000, 2006. The 2013 'ethnically blind' constitution reset the franchise (common roll, no ethnic seats); the 2022 election produced the first peaceful, electoral change of government in decades. MI 0.692 -> 0.629 (Tier 2 throughout in re-score), P1 0.569 -> 0.591 (modest rise). Cycle apparently broken by the reset + turnover.

a_trajectory.evidence: P1 rose modestly 0.569 -> 0.591 and the 2022 turnover held, but MI declined 0.692 -> 0.629 (directional-only case)
a_trajectory.explanation: Directional call broadly holds - the cycle ended only after the 2013 institutional reset, as predicted - but the modest P1 rise sits inside the data-limited margin and MI fell, so PARTIAL not clean.

b_violence.evidence: Four coups (1987 x2 / 2000 / 2006), no large-scale civil war
b_violence.explanation: Ethnic cleavage + low-moderate P1 produced recurrent coups, not mass ethnic violence - exactly the Mod8 risk shape predicted.
b_violence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28: focus=Fiji pre-P1=0.569 -> LOW risk (MI v1, anchored)

d_failure_dimension.evidence: Contested executive legitimacy along the ethnic cleavage drove each coup
d_failure_dimension.explanation: Institutional/P1 failure dimension as predicted; coded PARTIAL under strict post-hoc-dimension standards.
d_failure_dimension.computed_config: Fiji: P5=0.80, P4=0.76, P3=0.65, P1=0.57 | all pillars >= median -> no binding vulnerability (management-load/high-capacity case; relatively-lowest P1=0.57)

f_reversal_risk.evidence: Repeated reversals until the 2013 reset; stabilized after the 2022 turnover
f_reversal_risk.explanation: High reversal risk realized, then declined post-reset as predicted.

analysis.overall_assessment: Required Pacific/Oceania case; the defining coup-cycle instance. Mod8 risk-vs-agency and Safeguard G Tier 1 both clean; trajectory PARTIAL (directional-only data, MI declined while P1 ticked up).
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Ethnic bifurcation + low-moderate P1 channels instability into recurrent elite coups rather than mass civil war, and an 'ethnically blind' constitutional reset plus one peaceful turnover can break the cycle without a large P1 jump.
analysis.baseline_impact: None; flagged DIRECTIONAL-ONLY (MODERATE data, P2 missing).
